problem: Students struggle to find compatible study partners for courses, leading to inefficient study sessions.
target_user: University students seeking collaborative study groups.
goals: Enable students to create detailed profiles
Automatically match students based on course enrollment, availability, and study style
Allow students to discover and join study groups easily
Provide scheduling tools for group sessions
Maintain user data privacy and security
Deploy the app using only free services
requirements: User registration and login with email verification
Profile management for courses, weekly availability, and preferred study style
Matching algorithm that considers course overlap, overlapping availability windows, and study style compatibility
Ability to request to join a group
In‑app notifications for match and group activity
Feedback and rating system for groups
Responsive UI for desktop and mobile browsers
Data stored in a free cloud database (e.g., Firebase free tier)
Deployment on free hosting (e.g., Netlify, Vercel)

user_stories.i_want: to create a profile with my courses, availability, and study style
user_stories.so_that: I can be matched with compatible peers
acceptance_criteria: Profile form captures course list, weekly time slots, and study style options
Data is saved to the database and visible on my profile page
Validation prevents incomplete submissions

user_stories.so_that: I can join groups that fit my criteria
acceptance_criteria: A feed shows groups ranked by compatibility score
Each group card displays course, meeting times, and study style
Clicking a group opens a detail view with join button

user_stories.i_want: to receive notifications about new matching groups
acceptance_criteria: In‑app notification appears when a new group matches my profile
Email notification can be toggled in settings

user_stories.i_want: to schedule group sessions via an integrated calendar
user_stories.so_that: We can coordinate meeting times easily
acceptance_criteria: Group detail page includes a calendar widget to propose times
All members can accept a proposed time and it syncs to their personal calendars

user_stories.i_want: to ensure secure authentication and data privacy
acceptance_criteria: Login uses OAuth2 with Google or email/password with hashing
All API endpoints require authentication
Data transmission is over HTTPS

user_stories.i_want: to rate and give feedback on study groups
user_stories.so_that: Future matching improves and low‑quality groups are identified
acceptance_criteria: After a session, a rating dialog appears (1‑5 stars)
Feedback is stored and can be viewed by group admin

user_stories.i_want: to deploy the app using only free services
acceptance_criteria: Code is hosted on a public Git repository
CI/CD pipeline deploys to Netlify or Vercel without paid add‑ons

user_stories.i_want: to search for groups by course code
user_stories.so_that: I can find study groups for a specific subject quickly
acceptance_criteria: Search bar accepts course codes and filters the group feed accordingly
All core features (profile, matching, group join, scheduling, feedback) are functional on modern browsers
No paid third‑party services are used
The app can handle at least 500 concurrent users on free hosting tier
Security tests confirm no exposed credentials
Performance metrics show page load under 3 seconds on 3G

risks.description: Matching algorithm may produce low relevance results
Potential data breach due to misconfigured authentication
Free hosting limits (bandwidth, storage) could be exceeded
Team capacity constraints leading to incomplete features
